patch.summary:
Thesis: Same category, different company size — Both sit in ecommerce, but documented company-size audiences diverge.

Same category, different company size. Choose commercetools only if your buying job matches “Composable enterprise commerce API — quote-only packages + 60-day free trial; contact sale” rather than Sellfy's shape. Choose Sellfy only if your buying job matches “Ecommerce platform for digital downloads and subscriptions — affiliate partner in ecommerc” rather than commercetools's shape. Workflow advantage: commercetools leans online-storefront, wholesale-b2b; Sellfy leans online-store, digital-products. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Same category, different company size — Both sit in ecommerce, but documented company-size audiences diverge.
- Positioning: commercetools is Composable enterprise commerce API — quote-only packages + 60-day free trial; contact sales. Shopify keeps the SaaS award.; Sellfy is Ecommerce platform for digital downloads and subscriptions — affiliate partner in ecommerce..
- Company-size focus: commercetools (mid-market, enterprise) vs Sellfy (micro, small-business).
- Workflow coverage skew: commercetools-leaning online-storefront, wholesale-b2b vs Sellfy-leaning online-store, digital-products.
- Researched limits: commercetools — No published monthly list price — hard to compare without a sales worksheet; Sellfy — none listed.

Limitations — commercetools: No published monthly list price — hard to compare without a sales worksheet; Requires front-end / MACH assembly — not a weekend theme launch; Sellfy: —.

Poor-fit cases: commercetools is a poor fit when that limitation bites: No published monthly list price — hard to compare without a sales worksheet · Avoid commercetools if you actually need Sellfy's motion (Ecommerce platform for digital downloads and subscriptions — affiliate partner i) · Avoid Sellfy if you actually need commercetools's motion (Composable enterprise commerce API — quote-only packages + 60-day free trial; co)
